title: Sea Breeze on 30A | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sea Breeze on 30A is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Looking for a home that brings you close to the best of 30A? This charming retreat in the Seabreeze East community sits just 0.25 miles from the public beach access and features its own private heated pool* and hot tub*, as well as a 6-seater golf cart. With 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms for up to 8 guests, this home gives families and friends a comfortable place to gather while enjoying everything the area is known for—from beautiful beaches to great food and local spots worth exploring.Step inside to a bright, open-layout living space where everyone can settle in easily. The large sectional sofa is perfect for movie nights after a full day at the beach or biking around 30A. The fully equipped kitchen includes granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a Keurig, refrigerator with ice maker, oven, and microwave, giving you everything needed for meals at home. The dining table seats six, and the eat-in kitchen offers an additional six bar stools so everyone has a place to sit. A shared bathroom and laundry area are conveniently located just off the kitchen.Sleeping Arrangements:Primary Bedroom: King bed, TV, cozy couch, treadmill, direct access to the pool area, and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower.Guest Bedroom 1: King bed, TV, and a private bathroom with a tub and shower combo.Guest Bedroom 2: Two queen beds with access to the shared bathroom.One of the highlights of this home is the covered patio that opens directly to the lanai-covered heated pool* and hot tub*. Sun loungers are ready for slow mornings or lazy afternoons. Enjoy meals outdoors at the table for six, catch the game on the outdoor TV, or fire up the private grill for a casual cookout. There is also a fire pit area for evening conversations.Please Note:* Pool heat is available for an additional fee, and the hot tub only reaches heated temperatures when pool heat is on.Nearby Attractions and Local Highlights:You’ll be close to some of the area’s favorite restaurants, shops, and family-friendly hangouts. Shades, George’s at Alys Beach, Peddlers Pavilion, Rosemary Beach Downtown including The Pearl and Sugar Shack, 30Avenue favorites such as Amigos, Amici’s, Idyll Proper, and Attycat’s Arcade are all nearby. For easy grocery trips or casual bites, visit Watersound Town Center with spots like Publix, Ambrosia, Village Market, Nigel’s, and Sweet Henrietta’s. Don’t miss The Big Chill, a lively hub with food, music, and activities for all ages.This home gives you more than a place to stay as it brings you closer to the local flavor of 30A, from beach days to memorable meals and simple moments that make a vacation special.Seacrest:Seacrest is a perfect destination with beautiful white sand beaches, coastal dune lakes, open green spaces, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Located near all your favorite 30A communities like Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, Seaside, and Seagrove Beach, you’ll have swift access to a variety of shopping and dining venues that are spread out along the Gulf Coast. The 19-mile paved bike path that parallels the entire length of the scenic highway 30A makes getting around easy.Your stay at Sea Breeze comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Snowbird Friendly!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars.* Pool heating is available for an additional fee.* Complimentary 6-seater golf cart***Please note that the golf cart will no longer be included with the rental after 2026 and will not be available for guest use moving forward.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods
